questions.prompt: The enemy had destroyed the walls before the consul arrived.
questions.answer: Hostēs mūrōs, antequam cōnsul advēnit, dēlērant.

questions.prompt: You have loved the fatherland more than your own life.
questions.answer: Patriam plūs quam vītam tuam amāstī.

questions.prompt: The soldiers filled the ditch with earth and rushed forward.
questions.answer: Mīlitēs fossam terrā complērunt et prōcurrērunt.

questions.prompt: Would that you had freed the captives who begged for mercy!
questions.answer: Utinam captīvōs, quī veniam ōrāvērunt, līberāssētis!

questions.prompt: You have known that man's character for many years.
questions.answer: Illīus virī mōrēs multōs annōs nōstī.

questions.prompt: The senators had removed the impatient tribune from the assembly.
questions.answer: Senātōrēs impatientem tribūnum ex cōntiōne remōrant.

questions.prompt: Have you heard the rumor that spread through the whole city?
questions.answer: Rūmōrem quī per tōtam urbem mānāvit audīstis?

questions.prompt: I would not have known such grief unless you had departed.
questions.answer: Tantum dolōrem nōn nōssem nisi discessissēs.

questions.prompt: The war must be waged with great courage.
questions.answer: Bellum magnā virtūte gerundum est.

questions.prompt: By seizing the citadel the general ended the war.
questions.answer: Arce capiundā dux bellum cōnfēcit.

questions.prompt: There was no hope of taking the city by force.
questions.answer: Nūlla spēs erat urbis vī capiundae.

questions.prompt: These things must be said openly before the people.
questions.answer: Haec apertē apud populum dīcunda sunt.

questions.prompt: Lead the troops across the mountains at once, general.
questions.answer: Dūc cōpiās trāns montēs statim, dux.

questions.prompt: Tell me the truth about that dubious matter.
questions.answer: Dīc mihi vērum dē illā dubiā rē.

questions.prompt: Do what the law commands, and fear nothing.
questions.answer: Fac quod lēx iubet, et nihil timē.

questions.prompt: Finish the work quickly, soldier, before night falls.
questions.answer: Opus celeriter cōnfice, mīles, antequam nox cadit.

questions.prompt: It is right that virtue be praised by all.
questions.answer: Fās est virtūtem ab omnibus laudārier.

questions.prompt: They forbade the gates to be opened at night.
questions.answer: Portās nocte aperīrier vetuērunt.

questions.prompt: The general ordered the camp to be fortified quickly.
questions.answer: Dux castra celeriter mūnīrier iussit.

questions.prompt: It was not permitted for the truth to be spoken.
questions.answer: Vērum dīcier nōn licēbat.

questions.prompt: I used to hear the birds singing at dawn in the woods.
questions.answer: Avēs in silvīs prīmā lūce canentēs audībam.

questions.prompt: I shall know the whole truth when the messenger returns.
questions.answer: Tōtum vērum scībō ubi nūntius redierit.

questions.prompt: The soldiers used to guard the walls throughout the night.
questions.answer: Mīlitēs mūrōs tōtā nocte custōdībant.

questions.prompt: I did not know then how great the danger was.
questions.answer: Tum quantum perīculum esset nescībam.
